name: Tohickon Family Campground
note: Part seasonal: a seasonal community and year-round monthly sites fill much of the wooded loops (winter-stored trailers on 2020 leaf-off imagery), with the nightly sites in the creek-side rows; open year-round. Approach by Richlandtown Road, since Google routes over a covered bridge with a 12-ft clearance. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: Operator rates/rules/monthly/seasonal pages (tohickoncampground.com, read 2026-10-21): 2026 nightly rates for standard and premium full-hookup sites, phone, online booking; Campspot (park 1937, read 2026-10-21) sells ONE weeknight (Tue 2026-10-27) on 16 standard + 10 Creekside daily sites, all 'fits vehicles up to 40 feet', and lists daily sites in December 2026 with no closure dates; operator's per-site Campspot map shows ~190 pads; seasonal sites by request/waitlist and monthly sites by phone, but 'we are not a residential campground', no homes or lots sold, daily share well over 1 in 10 -> real transient RV campground passing long-stay tests 2-5; price gate lifted: within 40 km of a family home (gateways.py)
waterfront_evidence: 2026-10-21: operator's own Campspot per-site map (park 1937) puts the 10 sites of its '30/50 Amp Creekside' type (044-045, 048-051, 059-062) in the outer row along Tohickon Creek. Esri World_Imagery (WV03 2025-09-20, 0.31 m) at z19 around 40.4532,-75.2745 and 40.4545,-75.2750: the new gravel pads of the creek row end ~15-25 m from the water and the open-lawn trailers in the NE corner ~11 m, across mowed grass and a single-tree-deep riparian fringe with no road, parking or other use between; Wayback 2020-02-03 leaf-off shows that fringe as one line of bank trees, not a screen. Operator Campspot photos (uploaded 2022-01-20) show the creek a few metres past a split-rail fence at a numbered site table and a tent trailer pitched at the same fence, and the bank fishable on foot. Creek ~14-20 m wide at the sites (<30 m) -> creekside, not riverfront. No dam involved: the campground sits on the free-flowing creek well below Nockamixon dam.
fees_source: https://www.tohickoncampground.com/stay-with-us/rates-and-reservations (2026 season, read 2026-10-21): Standard Full Hookup Sun-Thu $58, Fri-Sat $68, holidays $78; Premium Full Hookup Sun-Thu $68, Fri-Sat $78, holidays $88; 'service fee of $4 per reservation' (per stay, not per night). Campspot quote Tue 2026-10-27, 1 night, 2 adults: Standard $65.00 total and Creekside $75.00 total = site charge + $4 park service fee + Campspot's $3 booking fee. No resort/grounds fee.
booking_source: https://www.tohickoncampground.com/stay-with-us/rates-and-reservations (read 2026-10-21): 'Weekend reservations must include both Friday and Saturday nights'; Memorial Day, 4th of July and Labor Day weekends 'requiring a three (3) night minimum'; Christmas in July and Halloween weekends 2 nights. Campground rules page says reservations are 'accepted for stays of 2 or more nights', but Campspot sold a single Tuesday night (2026-10-27), so no standing minimum.
flags: Good Sam Park (10% member discount) and a 10% military discount (promo code MILITARY, not holiday weekends) per the prompt and the operator FAQ/Campspot deals - not written to discounts here.
Creekside call rests on the operator map + operator photos + legible satellite; the bank carries a single line of riparian trees between pads and water - AWH may want to eyeball it.
Seasonal share not counted: no source splits seasonal from daily sites; Campspot daily site numbers run 001-062 and 26 were open on one October Tuesday out of ~190 pads on the operator map.

Campspot's park record pin (40.4516,-75.2749) and RV Life's (40.4543,-75.2777) both sit off the site loops (Campspot ~250 m south in woods, RV Life ~190 m west); pinned from imagery to the middle of the site loops.
